requests.title: Multi-touch attribution modeling
requests.description: Support for first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and data-driven attribution models across all marketing channels. Essential for understanding true ROI of marketing spend.

requests.title: Real-time streaming dashboard updates
requests.description: Enable dashboards to update in real-time as new data streams in, without requiring manual refresh. Critical for monitoring live campaigns and operational metrics.
requests.notes: High demand from media and gaming verticals

requests.title: SAML SSO with custom IdP support
requests.description: Support for SAML 2.0 SSO with custom identity providers beyond Okta and Azure AD. Many enterprise customers use on-premise or specialized IdPs.

requests.title: Data warehouse native integration
requests.description: Direct data warehouse integration that allows querying warehouse tables without data movement. Should support the warehouse's native security and governance features.

requests.title: Cohort retention analysis
requests.description: Built-in cohort analysis for tracking user retention over time. Should support custom cohort definitions, flexible time windows, and comparison between cohorts.
requests.notes: Strong demand from SaaS and gaming customers

requests.title: Scheduled report delivery via email
requests.description: Automatically deliver dashboard snapshots and reports via email on a scheduled basis. Support for PDF, CSV, and Excel formats with customizable templates.

requests.title: Natural language query interface
requests.description: Allow users to ask questions in plain English and get visualized answers. AI should understand business context and suggest relevant metrics.

requests.title: Custom calculated fields
requests.description: Allow users to create custom calculated fields and metrics without writing SQL. Support for common functions, conditional logic, and aggregations.

requests.title: Anomaly detection alerts
requests.description: Automatic detection of anomalies in key metrics with configurable alerting. Should support Slack, email, and webhook notifications when anomalies are detected.

requests.title: Row-level security policies
requests.description: Define row-level security policies to restrict data access based on user attributes. Critical for multi-tenant deployments and regulatory compliance.
requests.notes: Required for healthcare and financial services

requests.title: dbt integration for transformations
requests.description: Native integration with dbt for managing data transformations. Support for running dbt jobs, viewing lineage, and using dbt models in dashboards.

requests.title: Mobile-responsive dashboards
requests.description: Dashboards should automatically adapt to mobile screen sizes. Support for mobile-specific layouts and touch-friendly interactions.
requests.notes: Deprioritized in favor of dedicated mobile app

requests.title: CRM integration
requests.description: Bi-directional sync with CRM systems. Import CRM objects and export analytics insights back to CRM for sales team consumption.

requests.title: Query performance optimization suggestions
requests.description: AI-powered suggestions for optimizing slow queries. Should analyze query patterns and recommend indexes, materializations, or query rewrites.

requests.title: Embedded analytics SDK
requests.description: JavaScript SDK for embedding analytics dashboards and charts directly into customer-facing applications. Support for white-labeling and custom theming.
